prompt: My inbox and head are overflowing. Walk me through processing everything the GTD way.
assertions: Capture everything first (mind sweep / collection buckets)
Clarify one item at a time asking What is it? Is it actionable?
Non-actionable: trash, incubate (someday/maybe or tickler), or reference
Actionable: decide next action; two-minute rule (do it if under two minutes); otherwise delegate (Waiting For) or defer (calendar or Next Actions)
Organize into the categories (projects, next actions by context, waiting for, calendar, reference, someday/maybe)
Mentions weekly review / reflect and engage to keep the system trusted
